title: Warm editorial visual direction
summary: A cream-and-charcoal editorial look with no competing brand hue, where every neutral is one charcoal base at varying opacities — warm, soft, human, storytelling.
defaults: Hue: warm near-black charcoal (#1C1C1C) as the only accent — no bright brand hue at all
Surface: cream/parchment page (#F7F4ED range) with one warm border tone (#ECEAE4 range)
Density: airy editorial rhythm — generous whitespace, reading-first typography
Build the neutral scale from the charcoal base at varying opacities (e.g., 4%, 40%, 82%, 100%) instead of separate grays
risks: Introducing a bright brand hue that breaks the tonal harmony
Mid-gray body text on cream failing 4.5:1
Dense dashboard feel where the direction calls for editorial calm
verification: All neutrals derive from one charcoal base hue at varying opacities
Body text reaches 4.5:1 contrast on the cream surface
Brand neutrals avoid pure #000000 or #FFFFFF and competing decorative hues, subject to explicit user choices

example_startups.name: Lovable
example_startups.note: Cream editorial neutrals: one charcoal base rendered at varying opacities instead of a gray scale

visual_rules: For brand decoration, prefer one signature accent used sparingly for identity and primary actions
Use a cohesive neutral palette; family tones are suggestions, not limits on explicit user design choices
Keep ordinary text, including button labels, at least 4.5:1 contrast and controls/focus states visible
Keep decorative hues restrained; retain colors needed for status, data distinctions, or explicit user requirements
